artifact_sequence.title: Owned FUSE Mount Engine, Supervisor, Resource Policies & Cache
workstreams: Ownership-checked FUSE launch/stop/restart and desired/observed state
Readiness graph, health classification, recovery and persistent retry budgets
Network/charging/battery/VFS policies, cache accounting, safe eviction and guarded cache actions
negative: PID reuse or foreign mount must never be terminated/unmounted
Explicit STOPPED survives reboot; remote outages do not create restart storms
Unknown metering never counts as unmetered
Cache traversal, active-file deletion and symlink attacks must fail closed

tests_required.targeted_validation: go test ./internal/mounts ./internal/runtimeauth; process-launch fixture; PID reuse, forged mountinfo, concurrent stop/reconcile, orphan children, mountpoint occupied and shutdown tests.
tests_required.negative_gate: A stray process killed, foreign mount unmounted, explicit stop forgotten, duplicate start or unbounded error tail blocks.
tests_required.promotion_criterion: Mount operations work independently without relying on PID/path existence alone.

tests_required.targeted_validation: go tests and table-driven readiness-state transitions; delayed storage, unknown-metered network, absent /dev/fuse, auth/fuse distinction, partial boot fixtures.
tests_required.negative_gate: Global sleep masquerading as readiness, remote-offline mistaken for absent mount, fake running based on PID or unrecoverable blocker classification fails.
tests_required.promotion_criterion: Observed health is truthful, reason-coded, and independently consumable by the supervisor and UI.

tests_required.targeted_validation: Fault-injection readiness/restart/crash tests, retry-budget timings, concurrent stop-vs-watch, no-duplicate-worker tests; selected Go race coverage where suitable.
tests_required.negative_gate: Unbounded restart storm, broken explicit stop, unrelated-mount restart or unowned stale unmount blocks.
tests_required.promotion_criterion: Recovery is targeted, bounded, inspectable and safe after daemon restart.

tests_required.targeted_validation: go test ./internal/policy ./internal/vfs; policy transition truth tables, profile golden cases, unknown battery/network, non-restart policy-only edit and clamp/boundary cases.
tests_required.negative_gate: Unknown metered treated as unmetered, profiles changing in secret, invalid durations/sizes or policy change restarting healthy mount blocks.
tests_required.promotion_criterion: All resource policies have deterministic decisions and existing WebUI inputs map exactly to backend values.

tests_required.targeted_validation: go test ./internal/cache; symlink swap/path traversal/root deletion, active mount refusal, cancel-safe traversal, concurrent cleanup, disk-pressure and proof replay fixtures.
tests_required.negative_gate: Deleting a stranger file, clearing active cache, stepping through symlink, reporting nonexistent storage or partial unjournaled mutation blocks.
tests_required.promotion_criterion: Cache maintenance is independently owned, bounded and safe for Android private storage.

artifact_sequence.title: Android Namespace Visibility & Root-Manager Lifecycle
workstreams: Read-only Android multi-user mount-namespace topology, exact target versus alias classification
Opt-in namespace bind planner with topology proofs, protected-process denies and rollback
Owned bind journal, recovery, controlled reconciliation
Magisk/KernelSU/KernelSU Next/APatch module hooks, install, boot, Action, uninstall/purge
negative: Never mutate protected shared namespaces or treat an alias as exact target
Namespace churn/identity mismatch denies mutation
Rollback only proven owned binds and never unmount unrelated processes
Uninstall preserves persistent state unless explicit separately proven purge

tests_required.targeted_validation: Proc fixture matrices for work profiles/users, alias-only, same namespace multiple PIDs, incomplete proc, namespace churn, misidentified protected member; host source contract tests.
tests_required.negative_gate: Alias treated as exact-path success, partial scan considered complete, system namespace treated as ordinary app, or default user 0 assumption blocks.
tests_required.promotion_criterion: Skybind can truthfully inspect Android app visibility without touching other namespaces.

tests_required.targeted_validation: No-root planner fixtures, setns syscall mock with controlled failure at each step, stale proof/race/protected process table, containment and transactional rollback tests.
tests_required.negative_gate: Binding into zygote/USAP/MediaProvider/ExternalStorage namespace, masking an existing mount, silent cross-user bind or partial unowned cleanup blocks.
tests_required.promotion_criterion: Only provably safe explicit visibility actions are enabled; unsafe or unknown topologies return informative blocked outcomes.

tests_required.targeted_validation: Interrupted bind journal recovery, PID/namespace reuse, stale signature, foreign remount, process-churn and read-only expected-state fixtures; real-device qualification separately guarded.
tests_required.negative_gate: Orphaned/foreign bind removal, double bind, stale mount identity, restart widening protection scope or false device certification blocks.
tests_required.promotion_criterion: Namespace visibility state is durable, evidence-based and has precise cleanup semantics.

tests_required.targeted_validation: sh -n/shellcheck where available, platform hook fixtures for each manager, corrupt-integrity refusal, idempotent boot, missing component, late storage and CLI/Action startup test.

tests_required.promotion_criterion: Root modules install/start safely and remain observable across restart without duplicate lifecycle logic in shell.

tests_required.targeted_validation: Owner/source corruption, foreign target, invalid marker, symlinked state and cache, interrupted uninstall and preserved-state fixtures; guarded real-device uninstall smoke.

tests_required.promotion_criterion: Removal is safe, reversible by reinstall for retained configuration, and purge only happens with valid express authority.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Owned process, FUSE lifecycle and explicit desired state
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Implement list/status/health and start.preview/start/stop/restart/reconcile using exact pinned rclone, --config, per-mount locks/logs/cache, typed argv and process groups. Persist user desired RUNNING/STOPPED separately from observed state. Prove ownership using PID plus Linux start time, executable identity and mountinfo; graceful TERM -> identity recheck -> bounded KILL; release only owned binds and FUSE. Return bounded actionable startup errors.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: go test ./internal/mounts ./internal/runtimeauth; process-launch fixture; PID reuse, forged mountinfo, concurrent stop/reconcile, orphan children, mountpoint occupied and shutdown tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: A stray process killed, foreign mount unmounted, explicit stop forgotten, duplicate start or unbounded error tail blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Mount operations work independently without relying on PID/path existence alone.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Dependency-aware boot/readiness and health classification
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Construct readiness DAG for root state/privileges, package integrity, /dev/fuse, storage availability, network link/type, configured remote, startup stabilization and Android boot milestones. Define RUNNING, DEGRADED, REMOTE_OFFLINE, MOUNT_STALE, AUTH_ERROR, FUSE_ERROR, RETRYING, STOPPED with nonfabricated reason codes; expose readiness blockers independently for UI/Doctor.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: go tests and table-driven readiness-state transitions; delayed storage, unknown-metered network, absent /dev/fuse, auth/fuse distinction, partial boot fixtures.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Global sleep masquerading as readiness, remote-offline mistaken for absent mount, fake running based on PID or unrecoverable blocker classification fails.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Observed health is truthful, reason-coded, and independently consumable by the supervisor and UI.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Per-mount supervisor, recovery and bounded retry
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Reconcile desired versus observed state using per-mount locks; classify transport/auth/FUSE conditions, preserve useful offline VFS mounts, track persistent restart attempts and backoff/caps, reset after stability, handle daemon crash/restart, network transitions and mount staleness without violating explicit stop. Do not cascade failures between mounts.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Fault-injection readiness/restart/crash tests, retry-budget timings, concurrent stop-vs-watch, no-duplicate-worker tests; selected Go race coverage where suitable.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Unbounded restart storm, broken explicit stop, unrelated-mount restart or unowned stale unmount blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Recovery is targeted, bounded, inspectable and safe after daemon restart.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Network, power and VFS profiles
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Implement network classes (any, Wi-Fi, unmetered, offline allowed), conservative unknown metered state, charging-only, minimum battery, min free cache, stabilization/settle policy and user-visible policy decision reasons. Expand Streaming/Balanced/Offline/Minimal/Custom VFS presets with canonical cache-mode/size/age/dir-cache/poll rules and advisory-only device recommendations. Never silently rewrite user-selected options.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: go test ./internal/policy ./internal/vfs; policy transition truth tables, profile golden cases, unknown battery/network, non-restart policy-only edit and clamp/boundary cases.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Unknown metered treated as unmetered, profiles changing in secret, invalid durations/sizes or policy change restarting healthy mount blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: All resource policies have deterministic decisions and existing WebUI inputs map exactly to backend values.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Owned VFS cache metrics, bounded prune/clear/forget
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Implement per-mount owned cache status, bytes/files/free/max/thresholds, aged-file pruning to low water, minimum free-space guard, clear.preview/clear, prune.preview/prune, forget.preview/forget. All destructive operations require stopped mount, exact owner/path proof, nofollow traversal, short-lived preview proof, consistent cancellation and audit journal. Keep protected files outside cache untouched.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: go test ./internal/cache; symlink swap/path traversal/root deletion, active mount refusal, cancel-safe traversal, concurrent cleanup, disk-pressure and proof replay fixtures.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Deleting a stranger file, clearing active cache, stepping through symlink, reporting nonexistent storage or partial unjournaled mutation blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Cache maintenance is independently owned, bounded and safe for Android private storage.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Read-only Android namespace topology and alias facts
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Bound PID/namespace scans (reference budget 4,096/512); gather mount namespace inode, group-member UID/command/user and mountinfo, classify system/service/zygote/USAP/MediaProvider/ExternalStorage/Termux/root/app scopes. Track exact target versus Android path aliases and per-user emulated storage topology. Report visible_at_target, visible_at_alias, identity_mismatch, not_visible, unavailable with confidence and evidence. Never take mutation merely from read-only discovery.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Proc fixture matrices for work profiles/users, alias-only, same namespace multiple PIDs, incomplete proc, namespace churn, misidentified protected member; host source contract tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Alias treated as exact-path success, partial scan considered complete, system namespace treated as ordinary app, or default user 0 assumption blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Skybind can truthfully inspect Android app visibility without touching other namespaces.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Opt-in guarded namespace bind planner and apply
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Implement an opt-in preview that revalidates exact Skybind-owned FUSE identity, destination path, supported namespace capabilities/topology, all namespace group members, protected classes, Android user and target occupancy. Bind only to explicitly allowed same-path targets; require fresh one-use proof and a namespace-identity recheck under lock before setns/bind. Journal each applied bind and unwind newly added binds if any step fails.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: No-root planner fixtures, setns syscall mock with controlled failure at each step, stale proof/race/protected process table, containment and transactional rollback tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Binding into zygote/USAP/MediaProvider/ExternalStorage namespace, masking an existing mount, silent cross-user bind or partial unowned cleanup blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Only provably safe explicit visibility actions are enabled; unsafe or unknown topologies return informative blocked outcomes.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Namespace bind ownership, recovery and rollback
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Persist exact source/target mount signatures, device/user/namespace identity and intent; provide rollback.preview/rollback/reconcile. After boot/daemon restart re-read topology and compare ownership before releasing, repeating or acknowledging bind. Ignore stale namespaces without asserting success. Release owned app binds BEFORE removing owned source FUSE mount.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Interrupted bind journal recovery, PID/namespace reuse, stale signature, foreign remount, process-churn and read-only expected-state fixtures; real-device qualification separately guarded.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Orphaned/foreign bind removal, double bind, stale mount identity, restart widening protection scope or false device certification blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Namespace visibility state is durable, evidence-based and has precise cleanup semantics.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Magisk/KernelSU/APatch installation, boot and Action
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Detect root-manager capabilities rather than names; support Magisk, KernelSU/Next, APatch and compatible module managers. Keep shell hooks thin; validate packaged runtime/manifest/modes at install, create owned private readiness marker at post-fs-data, start one locked daemon from service, reconcile via native code, and start standalone authenticated WebUI via Action/VIEW intent. Distinguish staging from post-reboot installed identity.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: sh -n/shellcheck where available, platform hook fixtures for each manager, corrupt-integrity refusal, idempotent boot, missing component, late storage and CLI/Action startup test.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Unsigned/corrupt payload accepted, service runs unsupported runtime, duplicate daemon or root manager name used as capability proof blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Root modules install/start safely and remain observable across restart without duplicate lifecycle logic in shell.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Conservative uninstall and explicit purge semantics
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Implement default uninstall preserving root-private configuration/cache and stopping only Skybind-owned processes, mounts, binds and transient tokens. Add explicit one-use purge-on-uninstall opt-in marker: verify mode/owner/location, nofollow paths, full source detachment and exact state boundaries before deleting. Never recursively remove arbitrary /data/adb or unrelated app/user storage. Respect interrupted cleanup/retry semantics.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Owner/source corruption, foreign target, invalid marker, symlinked state and cache, interrupted uninstall and preserved-state fixtures; guarded real-device uninstall smoke.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Default data deletion, unowned unmount/kill, implicit purge or partial device-level wipe blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Removal is safe, reversible by reinstall for retained configuration, and purge only happens with valid express authority.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Revisioned scheduled-job registry and due-run claim
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Implement jobs.snapshot/preview/apply/status and typed copy/sync/check definitions; bind source/destination/every, enabled and network/power policies, explicit destructive sync consent, per-job next/last/run-count state. Claim due work and persist its next occurrence BEFORE dispatch under per-job lock, guaranteeing at-most-once dispatch claim after daemon restart. Expose actions through same journal/proof engine.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Job schema, stale revision/digest, destructive sync previews, daemon restart at due time, duplicate claim races, disabled/policy-blocked job tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Executing sync without consent, duplicate scheduled claim, failure to journal skipped/blocked jobs, or option-like remote endpoints blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Safe scheduled-job intent and state are publishable independently of actual execution.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Managed job executor, progress and cancellation
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Execute only typed copy/sync/check using pinned runtime and canonical --config, with no arbitrary argv or shell. Bounded stdout/stderr and progress parsing for bytes/speed/ETA, structured terminal state, individually cancellable process groups, resource guards before/while running and per-job isolation. Manual job.run.preview/run shares scheduler safety rules; failures state clearly and never report false success.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Fake-rclone integration, injected mid-transfer cancellation, failure stdout, concurrent jobs, process ownership, sync/destination negative and policy-transition fixtures.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Cancelling unrelated process, accidentally executing a different executable, unbounded telemetry, unconfirmed destructive sync or silent job success blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Copy/sync/check are controllable, safe and accurately reflected in Activity and Jobs UI.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Per-mount authenticated loopback RC telemetry
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Start RC on 127.0.0.1 with random per-mount credentials in volatile owner-private state, assigned safe ports and lifecycle cleanup. Implement rc.metrics with allow-listed calls and bounded result projection for uptime, errors, speed, bytes, open files and VFS/cache data where supported. Differentiate unsupported/unavailable fields from zero. Never expose an RC URL, password, or generic proxy.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Cross-instance isolation, auth failure, port collision, missing RC support, stale credential and secret-canary fixtures.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Non-loopback RC, credential in logs/UI/bundle, accepting generic method, or cross-mount metrics confusion blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Each managed mount has isolated metrics with safe read-only typed projections.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Root-private remote discovery and bounded browsing
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Read canonical root-private rclone.conf explicitly; expose credential-free remote inventory, type/crypt badge, list folders/files for validated remote:path only, bounded pagination/limit/path normalization and breadcrumb/parent/copy-endpoint contracts. Record remote selection provenance for mount/job form handoff; invalidate trust if user manually modifies the chosen path. Reject arbitrary unconfigured backends/option-shaped endpoints.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Remote config secret canaries, traversal/on-the-fly syntax, invalid paths, huge directories, timeouts, plain/crypt classification and endpoint handoff tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Exposing private rclone.conf, shelling out with arbitrary option strings or claiming browse succeeded with incomplete results blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Original remote browser can run against secure, scoped, bounded backend operations.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: User-defined crypt password and safe crypt wrapper creation
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Support one user-supplied password via CLI stdin or secure UI field, private rclone-obscured storage, status/generation and non-secret recovery warning; never invent password, retain cleartext, set password2, or silently rekey. Preview/create a crypt wrapper through rclone with defaults filename standard, directory_name_encryption=true, filename_encoding=base32, data encryption via rclone; advanced obfuscate/off and base64/base32768 where supported. Reject nested/self crypt and partial definitions; verify result and undo only failed new definition.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Password stdin/secret-canary scans across all outputs, wrong generation, nested crypt, option whitelist, interrupted creation, cleanup ownership and UI request-shape tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Cleartext in API/log/report, crypt without password, a new self-reference, promised data encryption implementation or unjustified rekey blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Encryption management is correctly delegated to rclone and fits existing crypt modal without UI redesign.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Structured sanitized diagnostics and Doctor
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Implement bounded timestamped DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR logs, source/code/redaction/suppression count, byte-rotated owner-private files, query filters/follow polling and per-mount tails. Doctor produces PASS/INFO/WARN/FAIL with fixes for runtime/provenance, FUSE, platform, policies, mounts, namespaces, jobs, RC, remote/crypt, storage and WebUI. Treat expected static/read-only posture as informational rather than spurious failure.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Log truncation/invalid UTF-8, secret canaries, severity/category/query, tampered provenance, doctor partial availability, deterministic remediation mapping tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: A secret in logs, an unsupported function marked PASS, unbounded log query or false green due to unavailable device blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Backend has a trustworthy sanitized diagnostic surface suitable for existing Doctor and Logs screens.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Owned redacted support ZIP and evidence inventory
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Assemble bounded deterministic support ZIP under root-owned diagnostics/support, with manifest and per-entry hashes: sanitized config summary, operation/health snapshots, platform identity, namespace observation, logs and reason codes. Explicitly omit tokens, rclone secrets, RC auth, user password, internal paths beyond safe summaries and unbounded file contents. doctor.bundle.read may read only correctly owned Skybind-created bounded bundles.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Secret canary scanning of every ZIP entry, forged bundle ID/traversal, symlink root, oversized logs, partial ZIP and manifest mismatch fixtures.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Accidental private config inclusion, arbitrary file download, secret leak or success on incomplete bundle blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Support export is safe, attributable and reproducible where data inputs are fixed.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Standalone loopback WebUI transport and sessions
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Serve local assets only through IPv4 127.0.0.1 ephemeral HTTP with no-store/CSP/referrer/frame/MIME controls, one-use expiring bootstrap token, HttpOnly SameSite=Strict short-lived session, CSRF for mutating API, exact Origin/Host and request/response bounds. Route /api/v1 typed envelopes to same control engine as CLI. Expose skybind webui start/serve while keeping runtime state ephemeral and product configuration durable.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: HTTP token replay/expiry, cross-origin, CSRF/Host, XSS output, oversized body, idle-session expiry, fake route and UI backend-equivalence tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Binding 0.0.0.0, query-accessible arbitrary command, permissive CORS, browser RC passthrough or token leakage blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Standalone UI can securely exercise existing workflows without acquiring backend privileges of its own.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Embedded root-manager bridge transport and equivalence
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Implement fixed skybind webui bridge entrypoint carrying base64url-encoded typed request and bounded response. Discover supported embedded APIs by observed capabilities, never by brand alone; preserve request_id/events/errors and ownership rules. Fallback to standalone only after real launch/availability proof. Test bridge exceptions, unavailable manager, version drift and equivalent visual flow.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: CLI/HTTP/embedded contract triples, malformed base64, missing API, old protocol, transport failure, root-manager capability and notification/focus regression tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: A browser can execute privileged shell, missing bridge is treated as success, or transport changes backend behavior blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Embedded and standalone views share one feature surface with identical security and UX semantics.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Direct-copy frontend shell, tokens and baseline fixture runner
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Apply only Skybind-specific branding changes to directly reused WebUI assets; preserve all other UI/UX. Copy the checked-in reference WebUI files directly; preserve navigation Home/Mounts/Jobs/Activity/More, desktop sidebar, fixed mobile bar, topbar, badges, design tokens, dark/light mode, 760px breakpoint, motion and safe-area behavior, original local icon and assets. Delete only excluded-feature DOM/state/handlers and adapt backend calls through a tiny adapter; retain untouched reference hashes, source diff and deterministic snapshot fixture server. No framework rewrite or redesign.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Reference SHA-256 and DOM ID/token audit, static JS checks, 360/390/412/691/759/760/1024px screenshot fixtures, both palette modes, original-vs-copy semantic diff.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Changing nav hierarchy, swapping framework/design tokens, new icon set, orphaned excluded handler, unexplained visual drift or missing golden fixture blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: User-recognizable UI shell is copied rather than reinterpreted and is ready for progressive backend hookup.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Home and Mounts exact interaction and wizard parity
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Preserve Home hero/status, Runtime/Mounts/FUSE/Network four-card order, attention box, two quick actions, mount and activity previews and backend-authority/Refresh panel. Preserve Mounts cards/badges and contextual bottom sheet Start/Stop/Restart/Edit/Activity/Logs/Delete, config rollback and exact Source → Destination → Behavior → Review wizard: remote picker/manual entry/probe, destination suggestion, VFS/resource advanced fields, sticky navigation and proof-bound Apply. Keep focus return, error timing and unsaved-change behavior.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Golden screenshots for normal/loading/blocked/error cases, wizard step traces and keyboard/focus audit, mocked and real Go API fixtures, stale-proof/duplicate target/password absence cases.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Different wizard step order, different action-sheet semantics, missing fields or deceptive success/errors blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Home and Mounts visually and functionally match original UI with backed typed operations.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Jobs and Activity exact UI/UX parity
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Preserve existing job cards/form, enabled state, copy/sync/check type, every/policy controls, preview/confirm, last/next run, run/cancel, progress/status/ETA and error banners. Preserve Activity operation cards, grouping/order, timestamps, structured details, cancel availability and refresh/busy behaviors. Remove only historical out-of-scope controls while keeping the source styling, cards and dialog flow.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Jobs create/edit/run/cancel/unsafe sync fixture traces, Activity event/cancellation rendering, live refresh and empty/error screenshot matrices, keyboard/screenreader checks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Reformatting jobs as generic table, losing journal details, false cancelability, stale task display or unconfirmed sync button action blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Existing Jobs and Activity remain familiar and faithfully represent durable backend state.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: More, Runtime, Remotes, Doctor, Logs and Settings parity
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Retain More cards/navigation; Runtime provenance, immutable status, per-mount/VFS/cache/RC/policy/namespace sections; Remotes chips, browse breadcrumbs, folder/item sheet, endpoint copy/handoff, crypt password status and creation modal; Doctor severity cards, fixes, support ZIP; Logs technical list with severity/source/search, follow/pause, copy/export/clear-view only; Settings grouped cards, appearance, default page, dense mode, reduced motion, refresh and session idle, limits, diagnostics/About. Align settings options with backend without silently removing visible choices.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Per-screen reference screenshots dark/light and narrow/wide, browse/crypt modal traces, log filtering, support download, settings revision conflict and nonsecret transport tests.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Changing hierarchical navigation, deleting in-scope controls, misleading runtime capabilities, hidden credential fields or unapproved style drift blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Every More subview, modal, settings control and backend feedback path is preserved.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Responsive/accessibility/end-to-end dual-transport UX qualification
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Run original-vs-recreation visual and interaction parity at 360, 390, 412, 691, 759/760 and 1024px; dark/light, dense/default, reduced motion/enlarged text, portrait/landscape, keyboard open, long paths, offline/session-expired, modal/sheet, empty/loading/failure and stale proof. Verify focus traps/return, escape/device back, live notices, aria-busy, ≥44px targets, keyboard navigation and Android safe-area. Test all retained flows through both standalone and embedded transports; exceptions require exact screenshots, reason and reviewer decision.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Deterministic reference screenshots and diff policy, real browser scripted traces, a11y scanner plus human review; device WebView screenshots when available; explicit no-unexplained-drift audit.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: No golden baseline, visually novel UI, unapproved visual/flow changes, trap regression or claiming embedded parity solely from static tests blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: WebUI preservation is an independently gated acceptance contract, not a theme preference.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Whole-product fault injection, security and recovery matrix
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Build cross-subsystem fixtures: corrupt runtime/manifest, PID reuse, state symlink swap, stale proof, race in config, mount/namespace loss, cache pressure, duplicate scheduler claim, RC credential disclosure, nested crypt, interrupted provider action, log/bundle canaries, slow HTTP clients and crash during restart/uninstall. Bind each test to a unique issue/obligation and failed-vs-fixed evidence. Add targeted plus affected-graph retest and regression freeze.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Independent Go/Python/Node fixture suites, fuzz/sanitizer subsets, race tests, secret canary scan, integrity and source/API/full-UX closure; reproduce injected failures.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Any P00–P17 in-scope feature lacks an evidence owner/test, or any critical safety failure persists blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Integration and negative safety contracts are complete before device release attempts.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Arm64 install, ordinary-app visibility and endurance qualification
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Qualify each produced provider ZIP on actual declared supported arm64 devices, record Android fingerprint/API/kernel/SELinux/root manager/version/capabilities plus rclone/FUSE hashes. Test install, boot, Action, mount read/write from a NORMAL Android app, namespace churn, work profile if present, cold/warm reboots, multi-mount/jobs, network/doze/charging/storage/auth/fuse faults, daemon death, WebUI transports, cache, uninstall retention and explicit purge. Use Devtool device manager/ADB operations and shell/push/pull/logcat/screenshot as appropriate. If a real device is absent, mark DEVICE BLOCKED—not PASS.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Device facts capture, per-scenario immutable receipts, attached logs/screenshots, reproducible APK helper instrumentation only when an actual test-app target exists, targeted cross-provider matrix.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: A rooted shell being able to read a mount cannot substitute for ordinary-app access; an emulator/host-only result cannot claim phone/endurance pass; untested managers remain unqualified.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Supported hardware claims are backed by exact devices, both runtime variants and authentic app read/write observations.

original_remaining_implementation_obliga.title: Supply-chain audit, reproducible release and final seal implementation
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.implementation: Create final evidence crosswalk binding source commit, exact Devtool run IDs, overlay history, validation reports, package hashes, ELF identities, dependency inventory, UI screenshots/interaction traces, Android device receipts and unresolved-blocker ledger. Reproduce two provider ZIPs and checksum/provenance/SBOM sidecars, sign/attest where policy actually applies (do not impose APK signing on root module ZIP), produce docs for deployment/retained state/limitations/support. Implement project FS1 checker and truthful source-only vs device-release status. Invoke Devtool native final-seal as complementary target audit, not a replacement for Skybind-specific qualification.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.targeted_validation: Release manifests, checksum compare, clean rebuild, artifact registry verify, source-state/hash and device receipt provenance; tampered/expired/absent evidence rejection.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.negative_gate: Any critical blocker, stale device proof, unverifiable artifact, fake seal claim, unresolved UI parity exception or unsupported manager marked supported blocks.
original_remaining_implementation_obliga.promotion_criterion: Release and final seal are deterministic and evidence-bound, with no false promotion from source-only gates.

original_remaining_gate_obligations.title: Mount lifecycle, recovery and resource safety milestone
original_remaining_gate_obligations.required_checks: Run real Linux helper fixture plus virtual proc/mountinfo/FUSE scenarios, PID reuse, explicit stop stability, policy/VFS/cache symlink/disk-pressure matrix and supervisor fault injection. Require bounded retries and cache ownership.
original_remaining_gate_obligations.assurance_ceiling: HOST_LIFECYCLE_PASS; Android app visibility remains unqualified.

original_remaining_gate_obligations.title: Android namespace/platform source-safety milestone
original_remaining_gate_obligations.required_checks: Exercise protected-process scans, multi-user alias truth, safe setns planner, transactional bind ownership/rollback, module shell hooks and conservative uninstall. Require root-manager capability coverage without asserting devices not present.
original_remaining_gate_obligations.assurance_ceiling: ANDROID_SOURCE_PASS only; separate optional DEVICE_PROVISIONAL evidence, never a device release seal.

original_remaining_gate_obligations.title: Jobs, RC, remotes and crypt security milestone
original_remaining_gate_obligations.required_checks: Cross-check scheduled due-run at-most-once, destructive sync proofs, cancellation/process owner, loopback RC credential isolation, bounded browse/config secrets, password and crypt wrapper defaults/negative cases.
original_remaining_gate_obligations.assurance_ceiling: BACKEND_FEATURE_PASS; network/auth/provider behavior remains fixture-qualified until a device/network run.

original_remaining_gate_obligations.title: Diagnostics and dual Web transport security milestone
original_remaining_gate_obligations.required_checks: Check Doctor and support bundle secret canaries, HTTP bootstrap/session/CSRF/Origin/Host/CSP, embedded bridge request equivalence and fallback truth, source-only transport integration.
original_remaining_gate_obligations.assurance_ceiling: TRANSPORT_SECURITY_PASS; embedded real-manager claim remains device-pending.

original_remaining_gate_obligations.title: Near-exact original WebUI UI/UX preservation milestone
original_remaining_gate_obligations.required_checks: Compare immutable original assets and adopted ones, collect screen/state/viewports/both palette screenshots, flow traces, responsive safe areas and a11y results. Review every meaningful diff/exception; audit excluded-only controls are surgically absent.
original_remaining_gate_obligations.assurance_ceiling: WEBUI_PARITY_PASS only with real reference baseline; if Android embedded screenshots absent, mark its device slice PENDING.

original_remaining_gate_obligations.title: Whole-product source/integration and release readiness milestone
original_remaining_gate_obligations.required_checks: Run affected then full source/integration/security/reproducibility matrices, verify required real-device receipts when available; compile dependency and unresolved-blocker ledger and cryptographically identify candidate ZIPs.
original_remaining_gate_obligations.assurance_ceiling: CANDIDATE_READY requires all source gates; DEVICE_RELEASE_READY only with required real-device evidence and no critical blockers.

requires: preserved original WebUI visual and interaction parity

original_implementation_baseline.title: Product contract, threat model and UI reference freeze
original_implementation_baseline.implementation: Freeze Skybind-wide identifiers and forbid legacy branding in new artifacts. Freeze build-time NewFuture/bclone selection, root-private state, single bundled executable and FUSE-helper layout; enumerate every feature/operation/state/API error; record threat boundaries, Android capability truth, independent source-vs-device assurance and explicit exclusions. Snapshot original module/webroot assets unmodified with SHA-256, DOM inventory, golden screen/state/interaction cases and visual-baseline manifest. List every retained and excluded UI control, and never import historical dynamic-runtime or migration behavior.
original_implementation_baseline.targeted_validation: Schema inventory, baseline hash verifier, static forbidden-feature grep, 57-operation coverage check, freeze verification, threat-case traceability.
original_implementation_baseline.negative_gate: Unexpected old-brand identifier outside quarantined original-source fixtures blocks. An omitted retained UI control, a UI hash mismatch, an orphaned operation, or an excluded historical feature fails the contract. Baseline snapshots must be genuinely captured or marked missing, never invented.
original_implementation_baseline.promotion_criterion: A current-product specification, frozen UI reference and immutable operation/feature checklist exist; all later overlays can resolve against exact baselines.

original_implementation_baseline.title: First-class Devtool targets, graph, workflows and fixtures
original_implementation_baseline.implementation: Declare canonical targets, target-local read-only test jobs, cross-target build jobs, named workflows, release groups, path inputs/outputs, safe parallel scheduler limits, wrapper commands, target/runner/execution-environment identities, targeted validation recipes and Android-provider detection. Distinguish source-only, build, host integration, real-device and release gates. Register baseline/parity fixtures and a project-specific seal check. Keep Devtool as orchestrator: no duplicate test scheduler, overlay engine or invented validation state machine.
original_implementation_baseline.targeted_validation: devtool config/targets/groups/jobs/workflows/plan/preflight/doctor checks; invalid target reference, write-scope escape, conflicting output, absent interpreter and toolchain-negative fixtures.
original_implementation_baseline.negative_gate: Missing named workflow, unknown dependency, unsafe parallel output overlap, phantom Android device, or zero executed validation checks blocks.
original_implementation_baseline.promotion_criterion: The rebuilt repo is natively understood by Devtool and has machine-readable dependency/affected graphs and reproducible targeted test selection.

original_implementation_baseline.title: Go skeleton and root-private filesystem invariants
original_implementation_baseline.implementation: Create Go commands and package boundaries, canonical /data/adb/modules/skybind and /data/adb/skybind paths, separate immutable module bytes from retained state, owner-only 0700 dirs/0600 secrets, nofollow checks, lock/atomic write/fsync helpers and injectable filesystem adapter for non-root test fixtures only. Define run/socket, configuration, desired state, health, jobs, namespace, cache, logs, RC, UI settings and support paths. Compile Android arm64 and Linux fixture targets.
original_implementation_baseline.targeted_validation: go test ./internal/paths ./internal/atomicfile ./cmd/skybind; Go cross-compile; host fixtures for permissions, symlink traversal, partial writes and owner mismatch.
original_implementation_baseline.negative_gate: A symlinked state root, group-readable secret, invalid absolute path, platform override on a privileged build, or partial publication must be rejected.
original_implementation_baseline.promotion_criterion: Private state and executable skeleton are deterministic, testable without root, and fail closed on unsafe layouts.

original_implementation_baseline.title: Pinned NewFuture executable and canonical FUSE helper
original_implementation_baseline.implementation: Acquire the exact official NewFuture arm64 package with pinned digest; safely extract one system/bin/rclone and the official system/vendor/bin/fusermount3 plus required libfuse siblings. Implement source/ELF/mode/hash/provenance verifier and strictly canonical runtime resolver. Never search PATH or use untrusted runtime overrides. Package deterministically without executing the target binary on the host.
original_implementation_baseline.targeted_validation: Provider acquisition fixtures, archive path/symlink bombs, ELF ABI and hash tests; one-runtime binary inventory; reproducible ZIP comparison; go test ./internal/runtimeauth ./internal/integrity.
original_implementation_baseline.negative_gate: Two executables, untrusted helper origin, helper from bclone, modified bytes, PATH hijack, corrupt manifest or nondeterministic archive blocks.
original_implementation_baseline.promotion_criterion: A locally reproducible NewFuture arm64 artifact with independently attested helper provenance and an operational read-only status contract.

original_implementation_baseline.title: Pinned bclone compile and two-provider package parity
original_implementation_baseline.implementation: Build bclone from an immutable commit with pinned Android NDK and explicit arm64/ABI flags. Select exactly one rclone-family executable at ZIP build time; obtain the unchanged helper/library family from NewFuture. Produce canonical runtime.provenance.json, package/SBOM inventory, deterministic timestamp/order/modes, checksum files and release diagnostics. Verify build reproducibility and effective executable identity for both provider variants.
original_implementation_baseline.targeted_validation: NDK/toolchain/provenance checks, two clean-build byte comparisons per provider, one-rclone invariant, artifact verification, helper equality fixture and corruption/negative tests.
original_implementation_baseline.negative_gate: Provider mismatch, unsupported GOARCH/ELF, missing library, second runtime, unpinned commit, manifest drift or unverifiable supply chain fails.
original_implementation_baseline.promotion_criterion: Both build-time variants are reproducible and can be differentiated by immutable provenance while sharing the canonical NewFuture helper.

original_implementation_baseline.title: Versioned typed protocol, Unix socket and daemon authority
original_implementation_baseline.implementation: Implement one root-owned skybindd Unix socket with exclusive daemon lock, request_id and schema_version, client protocol min/max negotiation, classes query/preview/run/cancel/reconcile, strict allow-listed operation descriptors, bounded JSON requests/responses/events and stable categories/stages/retryability. skybind supports version, capabilities, rpc, daemon and machine-friendly event streams. Restrict local fallback to identical authorization semantics.
original_implementation_baseline.targeted_validation: go test ./internal/protocol ./internal/control ./internal/daemon; fuzz invalid envelopes and unknown fields; Linux socket permission/locking tests; CLI golden JSON/NDJSON.
original_implementation_baseline.negative_gate: Unknown operation, generic shell/RC/file primitive, oversized envelope, multiple daemon owners, unsupported version or unbounded stream fails.
original_implementation_baseline.promotion_criterion: CLI and daemon use a single typed engine with deterministic errors, no arbitrary command execution and no transport-specific authority drift.

original_implementation_baseline.title: Durable operations, cancellations and one-use proofs
original_implementation_baseline.implementation: Journal each operation before effects; persist structured progress, process identity, owner, timestamps, terminal outcome and interrupted-on-crash status. Implement cancellation only at approved boundaries. Issue typed digest/revision/action/subject-bound expiring single-use confirmation proofs, consumed atomically under resource locks; keep non-cancellable commit spans intact and expose list/status/cancel.
original_implementation_baseline.targeted_validation: Journal crash/restart replay fixtures, simultaneous cancellation, proof double-spend/expiry/revision swap tests, event-stream bounds and secret-canary scans.
original_implementation_baseline.negative_gate: Lost work history, acceptance of a replayed/stale proof, cancellation during atomic commit, forged request owner or leaked secret blocks.
original_implementation_baseline.promotion_criterion: Mutation tracking and proof semantics support every later transactional domain and the existing Activity UI.

original_implementation_baseline.title: Transactional mount registry, diff and rollback
original_implementation_baseline.implementation: Implement config registry-v2.json and previous-v2.json with canonical digest, revision, strict fields, normalized remote/destination, nested-target/private-path guards, network/power/VFS/cache settings, trusted server-only args_file and public has_args_file. Provide snapshot/validate/preview/apply/previous/rollback.preview/rollback; plan precise mount/policy/cache/namespace consequences. Atomically fsync/publish and rollback as a NEW revision with no unnecessary restart for policy-only edits.
original_implementation_baseline.targeted_validation: go test ./internal/mounts ./internal/previewproof; config golden matrices; interrupted atomic-write and previous-good tests; stale/digest/race/secret cases.
original_implementation_baseline.negative_gate: Duplicate/overlapping targets, arbitrary flags/browser args_file, wrong revision, drifted candidate or partial state blocks; unrelated mounts remain unchanged.
original_implementation_baseline.promotion_criterion: Existing WebUI configuration wizard can use a stable preview/apply/rollback protocol without altering its flow.

original_implementation_baseline.title: Complete CLI parity and API inventory lock
original_implementation_baseline.implementation: Expose the complete typed operation catalog with classes, argument schemas, response fixtures, stable errors, client capability discovery and CLI shorthand matching backend effects. Generate/test a machine-readable API inventory mapped to all original in-scope UI handlers, including future operations as declared yet unsupported capabilities until their overlays land. No fake-success stub may be exposed as operational.
original_implementation_baseline.targeted_validation: Typed schema/test inventory, request envelope golden vectors, CLI/daemon equivalence fixtures, requiredOperations crosswalk, capability/version negative tests.
original_implementation_baseline.negative_gate: An advertised nonimplemented operation, mismatched CLI vs daemon response, unspecified cancellation capability or silently accepted extra field blocks.
original_implementation_baseline.promotion_criterion: Every current-scope operation is enumerated and versioned; implemented subset is truthful and safely extendable by subsequent overlays.

original_gate_baseline.title: Foundation and static supply-chain milestone
original_gate_baseline.required_checks: Recheck authoritative contract, target graph, private path invariants, signed/pinned input authenticity where applicable, single runtime, NewFuture helper and both provider reproducibility. Verify no excluded paths/features entered new code.
original_gate_baseline.assurance_ceiling: SOURCE_BUILD_PASS only; device capability and FUSE usability remain NOT_ATTESTED.

original_gate_baseline.title: Typed authority and transactional configuration milestone
original_gate_baseline.required_checks: Recheck protocol/daemon owner lock, full operation registry, durable journal, proof replay/race/failure, config atomic publish/rollback and CLI parity under malformed/adversarial input.
original_gate_baseline.assurance_ceiling: SOURCE_CONTROL_PASS; no real Android mount, daemon boot or device inference.

preserved_contracts.frontend: Reuse original WebUI source directly; verify exact responsive visual and interaction parity, only narrow approved adapter/brand/exclusion edits
preserved_contracts.runtime: One build-time selected NewFuture or bclone arm64 rclone binary and official FUSE helper; no installed runtime update/select features
preserved_contracts.state: Root-private /data/adb/skybind state, transactional config, operation journal, mount ownership; no migration
preserved_contracts.tests: All original targeted validations and negative tests retained per obligation
preserved_contracts.gates: All SB-G01..SB-G08 still independently evaluated; definitions do not certify them
preserved_contracts.seal: SB-FS1 is a distinct final qualification artifact; physical Android and ordinary app read/write mandatory

host_validation_policy.termux: Use writable private temp path, never hardcode /tmp. Long Unix socket paths: short private sockets. Umask 077 fixture chmod and stat explicit. Race detector unsupported Android/arm64: record NOT_RUN and require another qualifying host for relevant gate, not PASS.
host_validation_policy.go: Run target tests + vet + cross-build through Devtool hooks/jobs; no output artifacts left in worktree
host_validation_policy.proof: Targeted validation, negative cases, SHA pinning, rollback, evidence receipts, source/device split

explicit_exclusions: obsolete migration UI and legacy campaign
release_blockers: SB-G01 and SB-G02 actual qualification blocked absent required independent evidence
Real NewFuture/bclone pinned provider build provenance required
Physical Android device and ordinary-app exact-path access required
All gate obligations, visual parity, secrets and safety obligations require evidence
